p.s: When I was a child I never like to go shopping because my Mum spend so much time on the shops that I remember going shopping with her, was a nigthmare.
It is ameaising how people change during the years, for example now shopping for me is one of the most entertaining things, and every week I have to buy something.
I enjoy so much fashion that my life change completely since I start to study clothes designer and I discover that fabrics, colors, are really enjoyable.

But in this days shopping is not always enjoyable, because if you decide to buy a very expensive designer and you pay full price, on the end of the season it is half price, I find very anfair for people who pay a lot of money on their clothes.
Anyway, shopping is allways a satisfation for rich people, because they can afforded and they don't main to spend full price on their clothes.
